title: Inventory page displays 6 products with add-to-cart buttons
steps: Verify each product has image, title link, description, price, and Add to cart button
expected: 6 products visible: Backpack, Bike Light, Bolt T-Shirt, Fleece Jacket, Onesie, Test.allTheThings() T-Shirt. Each has #add-to-cart-sauce-labs-{name} button

title: Sort dropdown has 4 options
steps: Verify 4 sort options: Name (A to Z), Name (Z to A), Price (low to high), Price (high to low)
expected: Sort dropdown with 4 options functioning correctly

title: Add to cart updates badge and toggles button
expected: Badge shows count 1, button toggled to Remove

title: Cart page shows added items with quantity and remove option
steps: Verify item name, description, price displayed
expected: Cart shows Sauce Labs Backpack, qty 1, price, description, Remove button

title: Checkout button navigates to step one
preconditions: Cart has at least one item
expected: Navigated to /checkout-step-one.html with Checkout: Your Information form

title: Step one: fill shipping info and proceed to overview
expected: Navigated to /checkout-step-one.html (overview) showing items, subtotal, tax, total

title: Step two: overview displays correct totals and finish completes order
steps: Verify subtotal, tax, and total calculated
expected: Navigated to /checkout-complete.html with 'THANK YOU FOR YOUR ORDER' confirmation

title: Step one with missing fields shows error
Step one with missing postal code shows error
